svg.text: The hardware underneath the software. Invisible while it works.
TIER 3 — experimental · you are the study
one red on the whole board = the delayed bill
THE PERFORMANCE DECK · BUCKET A (Part 3.0) — the part you already optimise
running warm · the hot catalogue, dimmed on purpose
the load pulls on the layer below
— the maintenance layer nobody photographs · ~55% of the board · fully lit
AEROBIC EXERCISE = the biggest BDNF lever
FREE · no compound out-performs it · the heaviest wire on the board
grows a healthy brain — the absence is the point
judge it on a slow verbal-memory PR, not a feeling
clips the toxic surge, passes the normal signal
but blunts the acute edge · preservation tool, not performance
predicts risk · not a brain reading
precursor largely inactive · the SULFATED metabolite works
and PregS is PRO-AROUSAL, not calming
gate tripped shut on upstream supply
HORMONES, NOT SUPPLEMENTS: test → correct a proven deficit → re-test
URIDINE + CHOLINE + DHA → SYNAPTIC MEMBRANE · the Kennedy pathway
miss one leg = nothing built · omega-3 is co-limiting, not garnish
"restores D2 receptors" · speculative tap up to the deck
feeds the trinity AND drops to the floor
THE BEST NEUROPROTECTION ISN'T A TIER-3 PEPTIDE
SLEEP · CARDIO · OMEGA-3 · STABLE GLUCOSE · DON'T OVERRUN BUCKET A
every bay grounds here · free · the biggest levers
the only thing measured in decades
invisible while it works · costly when you need it
SKIP NOTHING ON THE FLOOR · ADD THE MARGIN ON TOP · TEST THE HORMONES
the bottom of the board is the point — the top was never the hero
9th & final Cognitive Enhancement poster · the Cognitive track is complete
